args.subject: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail): label confusion
args.body:
June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion for Pellow Home Living:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code moved from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so searches and dropdowns on "PHL" can return both accounts.
- The Pemberline Dock export still shows the old Covey & Lark Retail heading, which has already caused a delivery mix-up at the receiving door.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living.

Could you check the CRM record name for the account? I'll keep working the export and report labels with support.

Thanks,
Sofia
